title: Effect of an Overturned Denial: Member Appeals Program
content:
A denial may be overturned in the member's favour, either by an internal appeal decision under the Member Appeals Program or by an external reviewer. In either case, the overturn reverses the original denial on the denial's own record. The overturn does not create a separate grant.

## What the overturn makes of the original record

| Denied record that was appealed | Result of the overturn on that record |
|---|---|
| Coverage review denial (Utilization Management Program) | Becomes an authorization, on the basis "appeal overturn" |
| Formulary exception denial (Formulary Benefit) | Becomes an approval |
| Paper-claim denial (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit) | Becomes an approved reimbursement |

## Duration and timing

- **Duration.** The approval runs for the period the original program's rules set. That period is counted from the overturn date.
- **Timing.** Coverage is put in effect within the package's internal-overturn period, in hours, after an internal overturn. After an external overturn, it is put in effect within the package's external-overturn period, in hours.

## Payment made by the member while the appeal was pending

When the package provides reimbursement on overturn, a member who paid for the drug while the appeal was pending is reimbursed through a paper claim. That reimbursement is paid within the package's post-service payment period after the overturn.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- **Formulary exception.** A formulary exception denial is overturned at an internal level on 5 June. The exception record becomes an approval. It runs for the period the Formulary Benefit's rules set, counted from 5 June. Coverage is put in effect within the package's internal-overturn period.
- **Coverage review case, external overturn.** An external reviewer overturns a coverage review denial. The review case becomes an authorization on the basis "appeal overturn". Coverage is put in effect within the package's external-overturn period.
- **Paid while pending.** A member paid for a fill while the appeal of a coverage review denial was pending, and the appeal is then overturned. If the package provides reimbursement on overturn, the member is reimbursed through a paper claim, paid within the package's post-service payment period.
